name: Sandra Armenta
office: City of Rosemead, Member of the City Council

items.text: Sandra Armenta is the mayor pro tem of Rosemead and a member of the City Council, first elected in 2009. She is a former special education and general education teacher. She works as a district representative for state Senator Susan Rubio.

sentences.text: Sandra Armenta is the mayor pro tem of Rosemead and a member of the City Council, first elected in 2009.
She is a former special education and general education teacher.
She works as a district representative for state Senator Susan Rubio.

items.text: She says the City Council has passed budgets without tax increases while maintaining services. She wants to preserve local control in housing development with community input. Her campaign says she aims to attract new businesses and improve city infrastructure. According to her campaign, the city has added amenities during her tenure including a skate park, a dog park, community gardens and an aquatic center. She helped create the city’s Public Safety CONNECTIONS forum.
